title: RBI gives Paytm Payments Services (One 97 subsidiary) in-principle authorisation on 13 Nov 2026 to issue prepaid payment instruments incl. wallets; system + cybersecurity audit report due within 6 months or the nod lapses; no wallets until a final Certificate of Authorisation; applied July 2026; old wallets ran via Paytm Payments Bank (top-ups barred 2024, licence cancelled 24 Apr 2026); One 97 shares touched a 52-week high of ₹1,960
